title: VW ATF Adapter
lead: A new transmission adapter for Volkswagen transmissions. It connects directly to the transmission in two steps.
steps: Remove the external cooler from the transmission.
Bolt the adapter directly to the transmission with the same 4 bolts that secure the cooler.
benefits: Uses the existing transmission mounting hardware
Reliable connection point for fluid exchange services
Less setup time, more efficient service
source: Vol. 26 No. 03 -  New VW ATF Adapter.pdf
